> 第258章 紫霄圣地（第1页）
紫霄圣地！（紫霄圣地！（第22页）牛二气喘吁吁：“王爷，您找我！兄弟们都出去追了，那醉道人的速度太快了！有人看到一道人影，从北面冲出城门了。”“我们的人追了出去，没有任何踪迹。”叶凡的脸色低沉：“我问你，我让你的人，在倭岛打听妙衣父母的消息。”“有什么消息吗？”牛二一拍脑门：“哦，王爷，这件事啊。”“您上次回来，就有消息了！”叶凡的脸色一变：“什么？为什么没告诉我？”牛二道：“您当初把唐姑娘父母的画像，交给兄弟们后，我们整个倭寇寻人呢！”“原本是没什么消息的，后来从一群渔民那里得知，唐姑娘的父母，好像是从倭岛东面的一个港口出海了！”“我回来之后，第一时间不是告诉唐姑娘了嘛！”叶凡的脸色恍然，难怪上次回来，唐妙衣的表现如此怪异。晚上一起睡觉的时候，唐妙衣还十分伤感！说叶凡要离开，很长时间见不到！叶凡还以为，自己要去中州，唐妙衣舍不得自己。看来，从那个时候开始，唐妙衣就已经决定，要出海寻找自己的父母！叶凡沉默了！他也在寻找自己的父母！唐妙衣也在寻找自己的父母！这种心情，叶凡十分理解。一旦有父母的消息，她立刻去寻找！距离他上次回来，已经过去快半个月，这个时候，唐妙衣绝对已经在东海之上了！“牛二！”“末将在！”“你亲自率领一个三十艘舰队，去东海找唐妙衣！无论是否找到，都要随时把行踪禀报回来！若是找到妙衣，全力配合她寻找父母！同时，通知我。”叶凡下令。“是！”牛二不敢怠慢，带着人立刻出发。……另外一边，镇北王府外。一辆奢华的马车停在这里，纳兰雪嫣每天雷打不动，去镇北王府研究机关！纳兰风云也雷打不动，每天提前来等孙女。今天一壶茶刚泡完，纳兰雪嫣就气鼓鼓的冲进马车！“我刚才看到，叶凡回来了，你这么早就出来了？”纳兰风云笑着问。纳兰雪嫣气的嘟起小嘴：“爷爷！叶凡他欺负我！”“哦？怎么了？”纳兰风云眼前一亮。纳兰雪嫣怒道：“他……他……他把我认成妙衣姐了！还从背后抱我呢！”“而且，他还说我小，气死我了！”纳兰风云听完孙女的解释，一瞬间明白了。“哈哈哈哈！”“爷爷！你还笑！”“噗！好了，你再多来几次，爷爷就有孙女婿咯！”“什么跟什么啊？我这辈子！都不可能！喜！欢！叶！凡！”纳兰雪嫣气的跺脚。……傍晚，东土，一片荒芜的大山深处。土地贫瘠！湖水干涸！地面裂开，寸草不生，宛若一片死地！一片又一片古老的建筑面，在夕阳之下显得格外荒凉。此地，正是当年的紫霄圣地旧址！“呜呜呜！师父、师姐、师弟、师妹……我来看你们了！”一道身影快速疾驰而来。暗处，刘家守在此地的探子，却瞳孔狠狠收缩。“我的天！真的是他……”

Zixiao Holy Land! (Purple Sky Holy Land! (Page 22)) Niu Er panted: "My lord, you are looking for me! The brothers all went out to chase, the drunk Taoist was too fast! Someone saw a figure rushing out of the city gate from the north. "Our people chased them out, but there was no trace." Ye Fan's face was low: "Let me ask you, I asked your people to find out about Miao Yi's parents on the island." "Is there any news?" Niu Eryi patted his head. Men: "Oh, my lord, this is the matter." "There was news when you came back last time!" Ye Fan's expression changed: "What? Why didn't you tell me?" Niu Er said: "After you gave the portraits of Miss Tang's parents to the brothers, we were all searching for the Japanese pirates!" "Originally there was no news, but later I learned from a group of fishermen that Miss Tang's parents seemed to have gone to sea from a port east of the island. "I told Miss Tang immediately after I came back!" Ye Fan's face suddenly changed. No wonder Tang Miaoyi behaved so strangely when he came back at night. When they went to bed together at night, Tang Miaoyi was still very sad! He said that Ye Fan was leaving and wouldn't see her for a long time! Ye Fan thought that he was going to Zhongzhou, and Tang Miaoyi couldn't bear to leave him. It seemed that from that time on, Tang Miaoyi had decided to go out to sea to search. His parents! Ye Fan is silent! He is also looking for his parents! Ye Fan understands this mood very well. It has been almost half a month since he last came back. At this time, Tang Miaoyi is definitely on the East China Sea!" "You will personally lead a fleet of thirty ships to find Tang Miaoyi. ! Report her whereabouts at any time! If you find Miao Yi, fully cooperate with her to find her parents! " Ye Fan ordered. "Yes!" Niu Er did not dare to neglect, and took the people to leave immediately. ... On the other side, outside the Zhenbei Palace. A luxurious carriage stopped here. Nalan Xueyan couldn't help but go to the Zhenbei Palace Research Institute every day! Nalan Fengyun also couldn't help but come early every day. Granddaughter. As soon as the pot of tea was brewed today, Nalan Xueyan rushed into the carriage angrily! "I just saw that Ye Fan was back. You came out so early?" Nalan Fengyun asked with a smile. Xiaozui: "Grandpa! Ye Fan bullied me!" "Oh? What's wrong?" Nalan Fengyun's eyes lit up. Nalan Xueyan said angrily: "He...he...he recognized me as Sister Miaoyi! The ground is cracked, and there is no grass. The ancient buildings look particularly desolate under the sunset. This is the former site of Zixiao Holy Land! "Master, senior sister, junior brother, junior sister... I'm here to see you!" A figure came quickly from the darkness, but the pupils of the Liu family's guards shrank. "Oh my God! It's really him..."
